alerts.title: New City of London Lord Mayor Seeks to Get Trillions of UK Pensions Invested
alerts.summary: Bronek Masojada had a reputation as a tough leader in the insurance world he worked in for three decades. He’s now planning to bring that same rigor to his role as Lord Mayor of the City of London in a push to boost the UK’s competitiveness — and put its trillions of pension savings to work.

alerts.title: U.S. President Trump names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
alerts.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
